# StreamHub

> StreamHub is a fast, responsive streaming aggregator and media discovery hub for movies, TV series, anime, live television, and sports schedules powered by TMDB.

## Features
- Movie and TV show exploration with rich metadata, trailers, cast lists, and watch provider links
- Anime discovery integrating AniList and TMDB
- Sports schedules and live standings
- Live TV channel guide and HLS streaming playback
- Personalized watchlist, watch history, and continue watching stored locally
